meta_description: One of five luxury condo units in the Providence, Resdience 5 is a 6-bedroom rental perfect for your next vacation! Click here to book a stay of your own!
description_expanded:
'The Providence' | Residence 5 | Rosemary Beach, FL

'The Providence' is an intersection of architecture, comfort and new technology in a series of five luxury condo units. This unit encompasses a new boutique residence by featuring a second-floor private pool*, fifth-floor rooftop terrace with expansive gulf views, and a stunning interior that is 5,863 square feet.

Luxury living begins on the base floor with dedicated covered parking for two vehicles and private residential entry via the elevator or stairwell. The second floor of this unit boasts luxury with a stunning living space complete with a spacious den, luxury appliances in the kitchen, and a wet bar. This residence offers balconies on the east wing and an outdoor living space on the west wing. The outdoor living space features a pool*, fireplace, and gas grill to complete your retreat.

Take the elevator to the third floor to find the first bunk room featuring a seating nook and access the shared balcony. The next guest bedroom to follow accesses the shared balcony and shares the hall bathroom with the bunk room. Following the guest bedroom is the laundry room. The east wing highlights the master suite with a luxurious walk-in shower and soaking tub, personal studio area, and a covered balcony.

The unit extends to the fourth floor where you will find a bunk room and two guest bedrooms. You will also be treated to an open lounge space, perfect for watching your favorite moving after a long day of swimming in the private pool*.

Visit the rooftop terrace by taking the spiral staircase located on the fourth floor. This final floor features a covered area with expansive gulf views for all guests. The fifth floor does feature a half bathroom. The private, residential elevator does service all floors of the luxury condo.

*Pool is not heated

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

The community of Rosemary Beach features a mosaic of neo-traditional planning while implementing the idea of a new principle of urbanism combined with traditional neighborhood development. This distinguished neighborhood features many independent merchants who join together to create a welcoming community of lively shopping and tasteful dining for the whole family. Enjoy your morning coffee at one of the local coffee houses or divulge in the savory entrees at one of the finest restaurants on the Emerald Coast. Visit one of the four district community pools in addition to enjoying the second-floor pool* in the residences or the 1,620 square-foot exercise room at the nearby fitness center. If you are a tennis player Rosemary Beach offers a racquet club specifically for you. Staffed with individuals ready to assist you with knowledgeable instructing, new equipment and accommodations for challenging matches.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights

Sleeps 16

6 Bedrooms (including 2 bunk rooms)

4 Full Bathrooms and 2 Half Baths

5,863 Square Feet

2nd Floor Private Pool *pool is not heated

2nd Floor Outdoor Living Area with a Fireplace and Gas Grill

Rooftop Terrace with Expansive Gulf Views

Gourmet Kitchen with High-End Appliances

Private Residential Elevator

Covered Parking for 2 Vehicles

First Floor

- Dedicated covered parking for two vehicles

- Exterior entry with access to stairwell and private residential elevator

Second Floor

- Private pool with a large balcony, fireplace, and gas grill **pool is NOT heated

- Spacious den

- Kitchen equipped with luxury appliance package

- Wet bar

- Half Bath

- Access to the stairwell and residential elevator

Third Floor

- Main master suite with luxurious walk-in shower, soaking tub, studio, and covered balcony

- Bunk room offering two twin over twin bunks with a seating nook and shared balcony access

- Guest bedroom with king bed and access to shared balcony

- Hall bathroom featuring a large shower shared between bunk room and guest room

- Laundry room

- Access to stairwell and residential elevator

Fourth Floor

- Guest bedroom with king bed and private ensuite bathroom

- Guest bedroom with king bed that shares hall bathroom with bunk room

- Second bunk room with two twin over twin bunks and shares hall bathroom with king guest bedroom

- Shared hall bathroom with walk-in shower

- Open lounge space

- Access to the spiral staircase or residential elevator

Fifth Floor

- Rooftop terrace with expansive gulf views

- Half bathroom

Additional

- Parking for 2 Vehicles.

- This rental provides access to all 4 Rosemary Beach community pools and beach walk-overs.

- The fitness center and tennis courts are a pay-per-use amenity.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 cancelation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancelations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
